name: action-tailor
description: Action Tailor - Bespoke Tailoring Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,CUSTOMER" -c "magenta,blue,green" "npm --workspace=action-tailor-backend run dev" "npm --workspace=action-tailor-admin run dev" "npm --workspace=action-tailor-customer run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=action-tailor-backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=action-tailor-admin run build && npm --workspace=action-tailor-customer run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=action-tailor-backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=action-tailor-admin run typecheck && npm --workspace=action-tailor-customer run typecheck
